SELECT `custom_fields`.* FROM `custom_fields` WHERE `custom_fields`.`seller_id` = 1 AND ((`custom_fields`.`flags` & 1 = 0)) AND `custom_fields`.`global` = TRUE

SELECT `custom_fields`.* FROM `custom_fields` INNER JOIN `custom_fields_products` ON `custom_fields`.`id` = `custom_fields_products`.`custom_field_id` WHERE `custom_fields_products`.`product_id` = 1 AND ((`custom_fields`.`flags` & 1 = 0))
SELECT `bundle_products`.* FROM `bundle_products` WHERE `bundle_products`.`bundle_id` = 1 AND `bundle_products`.`deleted_at` IS NULL
SELECT `refund_policies`.* FROM `refund_policies` WHERE `refund_policies`.`seller_id` = 1 AND `refund_policies`.`product_id` IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT `prices`.* FROM `prices` WHERE `prices`.`link_id` = 1 AND `prices`.`deleted_at` IS NULL AND `prices`.`currency` = 'usd'

SELECT 1 AS one FROM `purchases` WHERE `purchases`.`link_id` = 1 AND `purchases`.`purchase_state` = 'successful' AND (purchases.stripe_refunded IS NULL OR purchases.stripe_refunded = 0) AND (purchases.chargeback_date IS NULL OR (purchases.chargeback_date IS NOT NULL AND purchases.flags & '512' != 0)) LIMIT 1

statements.sql: SELECT `affiliates`.`id`, `affiliates`.`seller_id`, `affiliates`.`affiliate_user_id`, `affiliates`.`affiliate_basis_points`, `affiliates`.`created_at`, `affiliates`.`updated_at`, `affiliates`.`deleted_at`, `affiliates`.`flags`, `affiliates`.`destination_url`, `affiliates`.`type` FROM `affiliates` INNER JOIN `affiliates_links` ON `affiliates`.`id` = `affiliates_links`.`affiliate_id` LEFT OUTER JOIN `collaborator_invitations` ON `collaborator_invitations`.`collaborator_id` = `affiliates`.`id` WHERE `affiliates_links`.`link_id` = 1 AND `affiliates`.`type` = 'Collaborator' AND `collaborator_invitations`.`id` IS NULL AND `affiliates`.`deleted_at` IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT `custom_fields`.* FROM `custom_fields` WHERE `custom_fields`.`seller_id` = 1 AND ((`custom_fields`.`flags` & 1 = 0)) AND `custom_fields`.`global` = TRUE

SELECT `custom_fields`.* FROM `custom_fields` INNER JOIN `custom_fields_products` ON `custom_fields`.`id` = `custom_fields_products`.`custom_field_id` WHERE `custom_fields_products`.`product_id` = 1 AND ((`custom_fields`.`flags` & 1 = 0))
SELECT `bundle_products`.* FROM `bundle_products` WHERE `bundle_products`.`bundle_id` = 1 AND `bundle_products`.`deleted_at` IS NULL
SELECT `refund_policies`.* FROM `refund_policies` WHERE `refund_policies`.`seller_id` = 1 AND `refund_policies`.`product_id` IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT `custom_fields`.* FROM `custom_fields` WHERE `custom_fields`.`seller_id` = 1 AND ((`custom_fields`.`flags` & 1 = 0)) AND `custom_fields`.`global` = TRUE

SELECT `custom_fields`.* FROM `custom_fields` INNER JOIN `custom_fields_products` ON `custom_fields`.`id` = `custom_fields_products`.`custom_field_id` WHERE `custom_fields_products`.`product_id` = 1 AND ((`custom_fields`.`flags` & 1 = 0))
SELECT `bundle_products`.* FROM `bundle_products` WHERE `bundle_products`.`bundle_id` = 1 AND `bundle_products`.`deleted_at` IS NULL
SELECT `refund_policies`.* FROM `refund_policies` WHERE `refund_policies`.`seller_id` = 1 AND `refund_policies`.`product_id` IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT `prices`.* FROM `prices` WHERE `prices`.`link_id` = 1 AND `prices`.`deleted_at` IS NULL AND `prices`.`currency` = 'usd'

SELECT 1 AS one FROM `purchases` WHERE `purchases`.`link_id` = 1 AND `purchases`.`purchase_state` = 'successful' AND (purchases.stripe_refunded IS NULL OR purchases.stripe_refunded = 0) AND (purchases.chargeback_date IS NULL OR (purchases.chargeback_date IS NOT NULL AND purchases.flags & '512' != 0)) LIMIT 1
